title: VictoryHoldReset
description: A broken, decaying victory hold is over and its progress is 0 (CONTRACTS §6; GAMEPLAY §9; ECONOMY EC-9a, Q-TD-102, Q-TD-126; NX-489): on the first running tick its decayed progress reaches 0 (DECAYED), or, with campaign.victory.reset_on_repair, the other side owns one of the broken hold's nodes at its full defense HP (REPAIRED). Only with campaign.victory.hold_break decay. Public, like VictoryHoldStarted.

reason.description: DECAYED: the progress drained to 0. REPAIRED: a broken-hold node the other side owns is back at full defense HP (checked when the progress is still above 0).

node_id.description: REPAIRED: the repaired node, the lowest id when several are; null for DECAYED.
